title: Vibrant Collage Mosaic
description: A six-panel collage featuring a partial woman's portrait with dark hair, a colorful courtyard scene with a door and potted flowers, a dramatic swirling sunset over water with a distant city, a stylized bright green dog head on a pink background, a serene lakeside landscape with trees and hills, and an abstract floral pattern in the bottom left.
prompt: A vibrant six-panel collage artwork combining a partial realistic woman's portrait with dark hair, a colorful Spanish-style courtyard with potted plants, a dramatic swirling fiery sunset over a reflective lake with city silhouette, a stylized lime green dog head with black outlines on solid pink, a peaceful blue lake landscape with green hills and pine trees, and an abstract floral pattern in bright colors, all merged together in a dynamic composition.
